proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.spawned_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is an activated magic item that creates, commands, and dismisses a companion with explicit initiative, obedience, and disappearance rules. Companion-creation payloads exist only for spells today, so there is no honest magic-item family that can carry this behavior.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental.

notes: Do not coerce this into grant_spell_access or a passive/activation placeholder. The item directly creates a Fire Elemental with fixed control and dismissal semantics, but magic items cannot currently use the spawned_creature family.
